//: Compiler settings shared by every TypeScript project (src, test, scripts): strict mode plus every additional safety flag. esModuleInterop and allowSyntheticDefaultImports are set false explicitly (module nodenext would otherwise enable esModuleInterop implicitly, emitting __importStar helpers) and skipLibCheck is never set: CommonJS interop stays explicit and every dependency's declarations are type-checked. Node types come from @types/node@22, matching the consumer engines range, so no newer Node API can creep in.
